text:
maria: Heads up — support escalation from Clipper: seeing ~10-15% 5xx (502/504) + timeouts hitting hosted inference endpoints in sfo2 since ~15:30 PST. They also reported auth token retries on some requests. Can infra/ops take a look?

jia: Looking at routing/edge metrics. P50 for /v1/generate in sfo2 jumped from 180ms -> 420ms around 15:28. Error rate spike matches.

ops-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api-sfo2: 5xx-rate > 8% for 15m. Triggered on-call pager.

kevin: I see increased TCP retransmits on sfo2 interconnect uplink. BGP peer 198.51.100.1 shows path jitter and a couple short flaps between 15:10-15:35. Quick snippet:

```
Interface: eth1
15m tx_retransmits: +1248
tx_errors: 0
bgp peer 198.51.100.1: 2 session resets (15:12, 15:33)
netstat -s | grep retransmit: TCP retransmits: 3.1% -> 7.8%
```

cory: Customer repro steps: they ran 500 small requests (<=64B prompt) over 10m; saw ~12% return 502 after 1.1s, otherwise succeeded. Provided curl and response logs.

alice: Could be MTU/fragmentation or provider microbursts — fragmentation/reassembly at the provider side often gives these intermittent 502s for short requests. Any packet-level pcap or icmp probing?

jia: Started continuous pings and small TCP probes to the provider edge from sfo2-edge1 and sfo2-edge2. Observed occasional 30-150ms RTT spikes and 0.6% packet loss to the provider next-hop.

kevin: Opened ticket with transit provider (TICKET-4329). They acknowledge elevated retransmits, say they have a partial device issue in SFO2 POP and are investigating path engineering.

maria: Customer is pressing for a workaround. Can we route this customer's traffic to a different peer/region temporarily?

kevin: We can apply route preference to prefer alt peer for the affected prefixes for that account. Rolling out a traffic steering policy now for Clipper (account-id: acct-clpr). Will monitor impact.

support-bot: Action: created incident IN-2026-045; linked support ticket TICKET-4329; cc: network-oncall.

jia: After steering 40% of traffic off the impacted peer, observed immediate drop in 5xx for that subset to ~1.5%. Overall cluster 5xx dropped to ~4% and trending down.

cory: Customer confirmed partial improvement on their side: errors down to ~2% for their v2 model calls. They still see small tail latency spikes.

kevin: Provider reports they've replaced a forwarding card and are doing re-routes; they expect stabilization in next 45-60m. We'll keep the steering in place until fully green.

maria: Thanks — please add mitigation timeline to incident page and cc the customer success team so they can update Clipper.

kevin: Done. Added runbook note: "when provider interconnect jitter causes >5% retransmits, apply account-scoped route preference to alt-peer and notify provider; escalate if not resolved in 60m."

maria: Nice. Post-incident follow-ups: 1) add provider monitoring to BGP runbook 2) create alert for cross-zone retransmit spikes 3) verify fallback policy covers model variant latency budget.

ops-bot: Incident IN-2026-045 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Last update: 1717208420.

maria: Customer success confirmed Clipper received update and will test for 24h before closing. Closing thread when we have provider confirmation. :white_check_mark:
